newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan President Jan-Aug profits rise.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan President Jan-Aug profits rise.

text.p: Taiwan's food giant President Enterprises Corp said on Tuesday its combined pre-tax profit for the first eight months of 1996 rose to T$1.99 billion from T$1.38 billion in the same period in 1995.
Sales rose to T$18.31 billion from T$17.22 billion a year earlier, President said in a statement.
For August alone, President posted a pre-tax profit of T$254 million on sales of T$2.75 billion, up from 1995's pre-tax profit of T$170 million on sales of T$2.34 billion.
President Enterprises, Taiwan's largest processed food company by sales, has set a 1996 pre-tax profit target of T$4.6 billion on sales of T$27.2 billion.
